# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> 9 Castleview Drive is a modern three-bedroom end-of-terrace house offering spacious living accommodation with rear garden and side access. Presented in good condition throughout, the property benefits from renovated bathrooms, natural gas central heating and double-glazed PVC windows. Communal on-street car parking The ground floor comprises an entrance hall with guest w.c.
